title: Stream crossings on the block
description: The block's one question about streams: whether its roads or harvesting will change a stream at all, and, if so, whether each crossing is listed so that it is answered on its own. Each listed crossing is reviewed one at a time under the crossing releases (the Water Sustainability Act and Regulation in bc.water-crossings, FPPR §§55–57, 72 and 73 in bc.fppr-crossings), so a crossing with no authority is never hidden behind one that has one. Every answer is the reviewer's.

relatedPacks.relationship: Each listed crossing's authority under Water Sustainability Act §11(2) and the Regulation's conditions; release 1.0.0 asked them once for the block.
Each listed crossing under FPPR §§55–57, 72 and 73.

facts.label: Will the block’s roads or harvesting make any change in and about a stream: a culvert, bridge, ford, ice bridge, snowfill or other work in a stream channel or modifying a stream, a wetland, spring or dry channel included (Water Sustainability Act §1)?
Is every crossing the block’s roads or harvesting make listed under Stream crossings, to be answered one at a time?

rules.title: Changes in and about a stream · one crossing at a time
rules.finding: Changes in and about a stream may only be made in accordance with a change approval, the regulations, an authorization or an order, and each crossing rests on its own. On these answers the block makes changes in and about a stream that are not yet listed, so no crossing’s authority has been reviewed.

actions.description: List each crossing the block’s roads and harvesting make under Stream crossings, with its role and structure, and answer its questions there.
